name: Customize My Account for WooCommerce – Dashboard, Endpoints & Design
author: Coder IT Solution

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce ‘My Account’ page with our premium My Account Customizer! Our modern customizer lets you edit default endpoints, manage user avatars, create custom tabs, and transform the user dashboard into a premium, responsive experience. This version 1.1.4 update brings a massive UI overhaul, introducing world-class design modes and an intelligent dashboard experience. It’s the perfect solution for store owners looking to create a high-ticket, professional environment for their customers.

Key Features

  • Premium Design Modes: Choose from three world-class themes Modern (Glassmorphism), Dark (Neon/Night Mode), or Simple (Clean Minimalist).

  • Sidebar Visibility: Advanced logic that automatically hides the sidebar when empty and expands your content area to 100% full-width for a perfect layout.

  • Modernized Admin Dashboard: A completely redesigned, card-based settings page with high-end toggle switches and custom range sliders for a professional feel.

  • Personalized Greetings: Welcome your customers with custom “Welcome Back” messages and dynamic avatar animations (Modern Mode).

  • Advanced Avatar Controls: Complete control over user profile pictures. Enable or disable user avatar uploads, set a custom global avatar size using a slider, and easily hide usernames for a much cleaner layout.

  • Flexible Navigation: Position your menus on the Left, Right, or Top (Horizontal) with just a click.

  • Custom Color Priority: New logic ensures your brand colors (backgrounds, hovers, icons) always take precedence over default styles.

  • High-Contrast Dark Mode: Refined icons and typography optimized specifically for high visibility in dark environments.

  • Responsive & Lightweight: Lean, professional CSS that keeps your site fast while looking stunning on all devices.

  • Elementor Page Builder My Account Widgets Now you can use My Account page using Elementor Page Builder.

Elevate your WooCommerce store and WOW your customers with a premium dashboard experience!
sections.installation:
1. Login in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins => Add New from left menu bar.
  3. Now search “Customize My Account for WooCommerce” in search box.
  4. Click on Install Now button
  5. Then activate the plugin.
  6. Woocommerce my account > Settings > Save your Settings.
  7. Check Frontend My Account page.
